name: sw-thread-audit-local
description: Local SolidWorks thread and hole-side audit MCP plugin.

interface.shortDescription: Run local SolidWorks thread/hole audits and comparison reports from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to the local SolidWorks thread audit worker through MCP. Supports local audit runs, with/without-thread comparison Excel output, and issue location entry points.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the local SolidWorks thread audit MCP tools.
